newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-NSW, Victoria off to contrasting Shield starts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-NSW, Victoria off to contrasting Shield starts.

text.p: New South Wales were 80 for one at lunch on the first day of their Sheffield Shield match against Queensland at Bankstown Oval on Friday after captain Greg Matthews won the toss and decided to bat.
Australia captain Mark Taylor was 45 not out at the break, with test team-mate Steve Waugh on seven.
Waugh came to the crease after opener Michael Slater fell for 26, caught behind by test wicketkeeper Ian Healy from the bowling of Scott Muller.
Taylor and Slater brought up New South Wales' 50 in 48 minutes after Taylor was earlier dropped at second slip by Geoff Foley from the bowling of Michael Kasprowicz.
Left-arm fast bowler Steve Nikitaris replaced test paceman Glenn McGrath in the New South Wales line-up after McGrath withdrew with a badly-blistered callus of the left heel.
Teams:
Queensland - Trevor Barsby, Troy Dixon, Martin Love, Jimmy Maher, Andrew Symonds, Ian Healy (captain), Geoff Foley, Mike Kasprowicz, Adam Dale, Scott Muller, Paul Jackson.
New South Wales - Mark Taylor, Michael Slater, Steve Waugh, Mark Waugh, Shane Lee, Greg Matthews (captain), Phil Emery, David Freedman, Stuart MacGill, Steve Nikitaras, Phil Alley.
In Melbourne, Victoria got off to a shaky start in their match against South Australia and were 64 for two at lunch on the first day.
Opener Brad Hodge and former Australia batsman Dean Jones steadied the innings after the loss of two early wickets, with Hodge on 25 and Jones 27.
Victoria lost opener Warren Ayres for one when he was bowled by Shane George in the fourth over.
New batsman Michael Foster was run out for two four overs later with Victoria's score on 10.
Victoria captain Shane Warne won the toss and chose to bat.
Teams:
South Australia - James Brayshaw, Mark Harrity, Jamie Siddons (captain), Ben Johnson, Adam Kimber, Peter McIntyre, Tim Nielsen, Geoff Parker, Joe Scuderi, Brad Young, Paul Wilson.
Victoria - Warren Ayres, Brad Hodge, Dean Jones, Michael Foster, Laurie Harper, Darren Berry, Ian Harvey, Shane Warne (captain), Paul Reiffel, David Saker, Brad Williams.
In Perth, Western Australia won the toss and asked Tasmania to bat at the start of their match at the WACA Ground.
The start of play was delayed for 20 minutes by rain.
Teams:
Tasmania - Jamie Cox, Mark Atkinson, David Boon (captain), Michael DiVenuto, Ricky Ponting, Dene Hills, Daniel Marsh, Colin Miller, Josh Marquet, Shaun Young, Andrew Saballus.
Western Australia - Mark Lavender, Michael Hussey, Justin Langer, Damien Martyn, Tom Moody (captain), Rob Baker, Ryan Campbell, Brendon Julian, Sean Cary, Matthew Nicholson, Jeremy Allen.
